title: Dana-i BLE pairing problem on Samsung S6 edge/G925F (zerolte) Android 12.1 (lineage 19.1)
body:
After upgrading to Android 12.1, AndroidAPS cannot communicate or pair with DanaI any more.

## Error messages: 
> ```
> Couldn't pair with JZ-DanaI-FI because of an incorrect PIN or passkey
> 
> ```
(ID anonymized)

#### Bottom of screen: 
> ```
> Connecting for xx s
> READSTATUS: Device changed
> ```
then overlaid by
> ```
> Bluetooth Low Energy not supported or device not paired
> ```

## Setup and Genesis of problem:
1. Previous setup AAPS 3.3.1.3 , Samsung S6 edge/G925F (zerolte) , [Android 11 (lineage 18.1)](https://xdaforums.com/t/rom-sm-g920-5f-11-0-unofficial-lineageos-18-1.4576015/), Magisk for root, but no Google/gapps.
4. Changed to Medtrum Nano for two weeks of testing. During that time
5. Updated the phone to  [Android 12.1 (lineage 19.1)](https://xdaforums.com/t/rom-unofficial-12-1-lineageos-19-1.4483531/page-31#post-90592092) (Procedure described below, in case it's of any help for others). Again, Magisk for root, but no Google/gapps. (This means that xDrip cannot communicate with TidePool, and Juggluco won't run either).
6. Medtrum Nano continued to run smoothly (two hours of downtime during backup-flash-restore, backfill even filled the gaps in data)
7. One week later... changed Pump back to Dana-i
8. Communication fails since then. The correct MAC is discovered, the Pump shows some communication, but cannot (re)establish pairing. remedies tried: 
    - remove pairing by long-pressing BT symbol - cannot reestablish pairing, but the previous pairing key is gone from the config file.
    - remove previous pump from config file (the pump had ben replaced)
    - remove all information about pump from config file
   -  deleted AAPS, reinstalled 3.3.1.3, no improvement
8.  Built AAPS 3.4.2.2, tried with old database - fails.
9. deleted and reinstalled from fresh database - fails. 
10. The Phone itself shows no pairing with the pump.
11. xDrip/Dexcom G6 is running smoothly. 

Attached: Logfiles from AAPS 3.4.2.2 after fresh install  (failed to upload, I'll try to add them in a comment)
In the logfiles, the ID of the pump is anonymized to `ZJ-DanaI-FI`, the MAC to `FE:xx:xx:xx:xx:C2`.
For example:
```
16:00:51.731 [DefaultDispatcher-worker-2] D/PUMPQUEUE: [QueueWorker.doWorkAndLog():119]: connect
16:00:51.735 [DefaultDispatcher-worker-2] D/EVENTS: [RxBusImpl.send():25]: Sending EventPumpStatusChanged[error=,performingAction=,secondsElapsed=1,status=CONNECTING]
16:00:51.739 [DefaultDispatcher-worker-2] D/PUMP: [DanaRSPlugin.connect():181]: RS connect from: Connection needed
16:00:51.743 [DefaultDispatcher-worker-2] D/PUMPBTCOMM: [BLEComm.connect():117]: Initializing BLEComm.
16:00:53.076 [main] D/EVENTS: [RxBusImpl.send():25]: Sending EventBTChange[deviceAddress=FE:xx:xx:xx:xx:C2,deviceName=ZJ-DanaI-FI,state=CONNECT]
16:00:53.080 [RxCachedThreadScheduler-68] D/AUTOMATION: [AutomationPlugin$onStart$12.accept():193]: Grabbed new BT event: EventBTChange[deviceAddress=FE:xx:xx:xx:xx:C2,deviceName=ZJ-DanaI-FI,state=CONNECT]
- [some Autosens, automation related stuff, followed by:]
16:00:53.571 [main] D/EVENTS: [RxBusImpl.send():25]: Sending EventBTChange[deviceAddress=FE:xx:xx:xx:xx:C2,deviceName=ZJ-DanaI-FI,state=DISCONNECT]`\
```


Thanks for looking into this..

comments.body:
## PS: Brief run through updating the phone (rooted, bootloader unlocked)
### Backup of AAPS and xDrip
Both applications halted to fetch their databases while quiescent.
```
computer% adb shell
zerolte% su
zerolte# cd /data/data
zerolte# pm disable com.eveningoutpost.dexdrip
zerolte# pm disable info.nightscout.androidaps
zerolte# tar czf /sdcard/Download/d-d-xdrip.tar.gz com.eveningoutpost.dexdrip
zerolte# tar czf /sdcard/Download/d-d-aaps.tar.gz info.nightscout.androidaps
computer% adb pull /sdcard/Download /export/Backup/Android/
```
### (flashed telephone with lineage and Magisk (for root))
then 
### re-enabled USB debugging, reinstalled xDrip and AAPS:
```
computer% adb install xDrip-plus-20260327-049ce18.apk AAPS-3.3.1.3-th.apk
computer% adb shell
zerolte% su
zerolte# cd /data/data
zerolte# pm disable com.eveningoutpost.dexdrip
zerolte# pm disable info.nightscout.androidaps
# remember uid and gid of newly installef xDrip  in  /sdcard/Download/xdrip.uid
# needed, since restore also restores the old uid:gid from the previous installation.
zerolte# ls -ld com.eveningoutpost.dexdrip > /sdcard/Download/xdrip.uid
zerolte# ls -ld info.nightscout.androidaps > /sdcard/Download/aaps.uid
zerolte# tar xzf /sdcard/Download/d-d-xdrip.tar.gz
# look up uid and gid in /sdcard/Download/xdrip.uid and use it to repair permissions:
zerolte# chown -R uid:gid com.eveningoutpost.dexdrip   
zerolte# tar xzf /sdcard/Download/d-d-aaps.tar.gz
# look up uid and gid in /sdcard/Download/aaps.uid and use it to repair permissions:
zerolte# chown -R uid:gid info.nightscout.androidaps 
# (it's safe to remove the cache files. If you want to keep them remember that they 
# have a different uid and gid following the pattern uid_cache)
```

Now that data directories and permissions have been restored, 
re-enable xDrip and aaps
```
zerolte# pm enable com.eveningoutpost.dexdrip
zerolte# pm enable info.nightscout.androidaps
```

Started both for the first time, and they just ran on, no new pairing need

https://www.gsmarena.com/samsung_galaxy_s6_edge-7079.php
S6 is BLE 4.1
Dana-I is BLE 5
try in on some recent phone

I may have to downgrade that Phone to Android 11 if that's the issue, and remain on 3.3 to get the loop back for now then. It was rock-solid in that configuration.
Thanks for looking into that.
